map.ICSI 单精子注射成功率评估器 使用指南: ICSI Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection Success Assessor User Guide
map.输入获卵数、成熟卵与正常受精数等实验室指标，结合女方年龄等因素，工具评估 ICS: Enter laboratory indicators such as the number of oocytes retrieved, mature oocytes and normally fertilized oocytes, together with factors such as the woman's age, and the tool assesses the fertilization efficiency of ICSI and the expected clinical pregnancy, helping a reproductive center with cycle counseling and quality control.
map.按女方年龄估算预期活产。: Estimate the expected live birth rate by the woman's age.
map.受精/存活/优质率测算。: Fertilization, survival and good-quality rate calculation.
map.年龄 35–37，MII 10/注射 8/存活 7/受精 6/优质 4: Age 35-37, MII 10 / injected 8 / survived 7 / fertilized 6 / good quality 4
map.：存活率 7/8=87.5%、受精率 6/8=75%、优质率 4/6=66.7%: : Survival rate 7/8 = 87.5%, fertilization rate 6/8 = 75%, good-quality rate 4/6 = 66.7%; the expected live birth rate for this age is 35-50%.
map.：预期活产降至 5–15%，建议充分知情并考虑供卵。: : The expected live birth rate falls to 5-15%; full informed consent is recommended and donor oocytes should be considered.
map.为统计区间，实际受卵巢储备、胚胎质量等多因素影响。: These are statistical intervals; actual outcomes are affected by ovarian reserve, embryo quality and many other factors.
